lines.text: Aniimo finally has a launch date: Sep 16, with Advanced ($9.99) and Collector's ($19.99) pre-order editions live now
Pokemon GO adds Mega Ascension Aug 31 - Sep 4, free 10th anniversary Mewtwo Timed Research through Sep 6, and September Community Day Classic on Sep 12
Battle.net has 40% off Midnight through Sep 13, and Midnight Season 2 with the Venomous Abyss opens Aug 18
Turbulent Timeways, Decor Duels, the Midnight Season 1 last call, Free T-Shirt Day and Nickit Community Day have all ended

needs_you.action: Finish the Choose Your Path: Venom and Vines Timed Research before it expires tonight at 8pm local
Buy the $4.99 Starmie Super Mega Raid Day ticket before it leaves the shop at 5pm local on event day
Claim GO Pass: Water Festival rewards by 8pm local before they expire
Finish the August Traveler's Log for the Ensemble: Midnight Outlaw and spend or freeze Tender before the Sep 1 rollover
Claim GO Pass: PokemonXP and 2026 Worlds rewards by 7:59pm local (rank earning ends Aug 30 at 8pm)
Finish the free 10th Anniversary Timed Research for the maxed-stat Mewtwo by 11:59pm local
Watch 4 hours of WoW on Twitch and claim the Sorcerer's Grassy Garb drop before Sep 8 at 10:00 a.m. PDT
Claim GO Pass: August rewards before they expire at 10am local (rank earning ends Sep 8 at 10am)
Redeem your 2026 Worlds Twitch Drop codes at rewards.pokemon.com before they expire at 20:00 UTC
Use the GO Pass Deluxe: August Lucky Trinket before it expires at 11:59pm local
Buy Midnight at 40% off before the Battle.net Game Deals sale ends Sep 13
Pre-order the Advanced ($9.99) or Collector's ($19.99) Edition before launch day if you want the Companion Handbook and the PlayStation-exclusive Fluffy Friend
Buy the World of Warcraft BlizzCon Bundle before it leaves the Battle.net Shop Sep 28
Claim every LEGO Stores reward, including the stamp rally Pikachu and avatar jacket, by 11:59pm local

games.typical_lead_time: in-game calendar visible 4+ weeks out; shop and patch news 1-2 weeks

timeline.title: Curse of Ula'tek
timeline.detail: The Coiled Isle is open with the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Curse Surges and Cursed Fishing, the Altar of Fangs dungeon, three new Delves, the Tidebound Grotto Lair, Housing Blueprints and four new neighborhood Endeavors.

timeline.title: Twitch Drop: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb
timeline.detail: Link Battle.net to Twitch and watch 4 hours of any World of Warcraft channel before Sep 8 at 10:00 a.m. PDT to claim the Ensemble: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb.

timeline.title: Trading Post: Showdown
timeline.detail: August's black-and-white western rotation offers the Hateforged Blazecycle (500 Tender), Badlands Buzzard (550), and Grandmaster's Royal Board (700), with the Ensemble: Midnight Outlaw as the Traveler's Log bonus reward.

timeline.title: Battle.net Game Deals: 40% off Midnight
timeline.detail: Midnight is up to 40% off through Sep 13; the 33% off game services and 50% off Warcraft RTS remasters both end Aug 24.

timeline.title: WoW BlizzCon 2026 Bundle
timeline.detail: Buy the bundle (Rabbit'ath Void mount, Ensemble: Garb of the Dawnfire Phoenix, Perch of the Dawnfire Phoenix housing decor) on the Battle.net Shop by Sep 28.

timeline.title: Catch the Drift subscription promo
timeline.detail: Buy a 6 or 12 month subscription to unlock the Sunflare Driftmoth skyriding mount and the Sunflutter Driftmoth pet.

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: The eight-boss Venomous Abyss opens Aug 18 on Normal, Heroic, Mythic and Raid Finder Wing 1 alongside Mythic+, PvP and Bountiful Delves; Story Mode and Wing 2 follow Aug 25, Wing 3 Sep 1, Wing 4 Sep 8.

timeline.title: Northrend Timewalking
timeline.detail: Run Wrath-era dungeons at scaled level for the weekly Timewalking quest and Timewarped Badge rewards.

timeline.title: Northrend Cup
timeline.detail: Fly Northrend skyriding race courses in Normal, Advanced, and Reverse modes for Riders of Azeroth Badges and cosmetics.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire
timeline.detail: Darkmoon Island reopens Sep 5 for tickets, profession quests, and the monthly carousel and top-hat experience buffs.

timeline.title: Cataclysm Timewalking
timeline.detail: The Cataclysm dungeon rotation returns Sep 15 with its own weekly quest and Timewarped vendor.

timeline.title: Pirates' Day (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Talk to the Dread Captain in Booty Bay for the one-day pirate costume buff and its achievement.

timeline.title: Brewfest
timeline.detail: Brewfest opens Sep 20 outside Ironforge and Orgrimmar with daily Coren Direbrew runs, Brewfest Prize Tokens, and the ram and kodo mounts.

timeline.title: Harvest Festival
timeline.detail: Honor Uther and Grom at their memorials for the week-long Harvest Festival quest and its bounty of food.

weekly_rhythm: Week of Aug 11 (now): Curse of Ula'tek pre-season week; World Quest Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown both run to the Aug 18 reset
Week of Aug 18: Midnight Season 2 opens with the Venomous Abyss, Mythic+, PvP Season 2, Bountiful Delves and Keys; Battleground Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble
Week of Aug 25: Northrend Timewalking and the Pet Battle Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Northrend Cup opens Aug 25; raid Story Mode and Raid Finder Wing 2
Week of Sep 1: Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu; Raid Finder Wing 3; Darkmoon Faire returns Sep 5
Week of Sep 8: Midnight Dungeon Event; PvP Brawl: Southshore vs Tarren Mill; Raid Finder Wing 4; the Twitch Drop window closes Sep 8 at 10:00 a.m. PDT
Week of Sep 15: Cataclysm Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Classic Ashran; Pirates' Day Sep 19 and Brewfest from Sep 20
September's Trading Post rotation has not been announced yet; August's ends Aug 31
just_past_window: Sep 22-29: Arena Skirmish Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Packed House
Sep 29 - Oct 6: PvP Brawl: Deep Six, with Brewfest running through Oct 6

games.typical_lead_time: events usually announced 1-4 weeks ahead; season schedule posted at season start

timeline.title: Choose Your Path: Venom and Vines
timeline.detail: Your locked-in Explore, Catch, or Battle Timed Research expires tonight at 8pm local, so finish and claim it before then.

timeline.title: 10th Anniversary: a maxed-out Mewtwo
timeline.detail: Free Timed Research for every Trainer ends in a Mewtwo with maxed-out stats, a Special Background, and the third Mega Level unlocked for Mega Mewtwo Y; claim it by Sep 6 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: GO Pass: August
timeline.detail: Rank toward a Latias encounter with the Lucky Trinket as the final Deluxe reward; Deluxe is $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, points are uncapped Sep 5-6, rank earning ends Sep 8 at 10am local, rewards expire Sep 10 at 10am, and the Trinket expires Sep 13.

timeline.title: LEGO Stores and Pokemon GO
timeline.detail: Participating US LEGO Stores host boosted Pikachu raids, a stamp rally leading to Special Background Pikachu, a LEGO-branded avatar jacket via Timed Research, and a SMART Play demo; everything must be claimed by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: Ultra Unlock: Water Festival
timeline.detail: Arrokuda, Barraskewda, and Cramorant debut alongside Shiny Ducklett and Dewpider boosts; catch bonuses climb to 4x XP and 5x Stardust from Aug 22, the GO Pass Deluxe is $4.99, and its rewards expire Aug 26 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Starmie Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: Mega Starmie debuts in Super Mega Raids with boosted shiny odds and up to 6 free Raid Passes from Gym spins; the optional $4.99 ticket (in shop until 5pm local) raises that to 14 plus guaranteed Rare Candy XL per catch.

timeline.title: PokemonXP and 2026 Worlds
timeline.detail: Pikachu in a Cosmog-themed spacesuit debuts Aug 25, World Championships 2026 Pikachu joins Aug 28, GO Battle League jumps to 15 sets a day, and the event GO Pass (Deluxe $4.99, or $6.99 with 6 ranks) must be claimed by Sep 1 at 7:59pm local.

timeline.title: Twitch Drops: 2026 World Championships
timeline.detail: Watch 30 minutes for Great League team-building research, 60 for the 2025 champion's Tinkaton and an Elite Charged TM, 45 on a co-streamer for Worlds Pikachu, and 30 on the PokemonXP panel for the Cosmog spacesuit Pikachu; every code expires Sep 11 at 20:00 UTC.

timeline.title: Mega Ascension
timeline.detail: Pick Chespin, Fennekin, or Froakie in branching Timed Research to start GO Pass: Mega Finale, with a different Mega boss each day, Mega Latias and Latios throughout, and the Remote Raid Pass limit raised to 30.

timeline.title: GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale
timeline.detail: The unticketed global finale runs Sep 5 at 10am to Sep 6 at 6pm local with eight rotating habitats, no Remote Raid limit, a CP boost for Mega-Evolved Pokemon, and Mega Mewtwo X on Saturday and Mega Mewtwo Y on Sunday in Super Mega Raids.

timeline.title: September Community Day Classic
timeline.detail: The next Season opens with a Community Day Classic from 2pm to 5pm local; the featured Pokemon has not been announced yet.

timeline.title: Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: A Super Mega Raid Day is dated for Sep 19 from 2pm to 5pm local; the featured Mega Pokemon and any ticket have not been announced yet.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local this season; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
Thu Aug 20: Spotlight Hour, Magikarp, 2x catch XP
Thu Aug 27: Spotlight Hour, Mankey, 2x catch Candy
Max Mondays: Aug 17 Magikarp (today), Aug 24 Hitmontop, both Dynamax
5-star raids: Groudon through Aug 18; Lunala Aug 19-25; Regirock, Regice and Registeel Aug 26 - Sep 8 (Raid Hours Aug 19, Aug 26 and Sep 2)
Mega Raids: Garchomp through Aug 18, Swampert Aug 19-25, Gyarados Aug 26 - Sep 8; Shadow Raids on weekends: Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) through Sep 8

GO Battle League: Great League and Scroll Cup (Great League Edition) Aug 18-25; GL, UL and ML Aug 25 - Sep 1; GL, UL and ML Mega Edition Sep 1-8; the Worlds arena and music run Aug 24 at 12pm PDT to Aug 30 at 11:59pm PDT
Daily Discoveries, seasonal raids, Raid Hours and Spotlight Hours all pause Aug 31 to Sep 6 for Mega Ascension and GO Fest
The Forever Forward season ends Sep 8 at 10am local; next Season's Community Days are Sep 12 (Classic), Oct 10 and Nov 21
just_past_window: Sep 26: Catch Mastery, with Max Battle Day following Oct 3

games.typical_lead_time: in-game events announced only 4-7 days ahead; DLC and update news months ahead

timeline.title: Fetching Scales for Feebas
timeline.detail: Feebas is in town asking for Prism Scales, which trade for event items including habitat pieces for Feebas and Milotic.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Enter code P0K0P1AGARDENS at any Pokemon Center PC (Mystery Gift, code entry) for a placeable Chansey Plant; codes are region free and valid through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the Ditto Rug at any Pokemon Center PC via the internet Mystery Gift option, no code needed; available through Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now
timeline.detail: Part 1, Bubbly Basin, is live on the eShop and needs the Bleak Beach environment request plus the new Dive move; buying the pass by Aug 31, 2027 also mails a code for 30 rare Pokemetal ingots, valid through Sep 30, 2027.

just_past_window: Expansion Pass Part 2 arrives in late 2026 with new accessories, furniture and Pokemon but no new town; Part 3 and its new town follow in 2027

games.typical_lead_time: official news posts land 1-2 weeks ahead; launch now dated Sep 16

timeline.title: Global launch
timeline.detail: Aniimo goes free-to-play worldwide on PS5, Xbox Series X and S, PC via Steam, Epic and the Microsoft Store, plus iOS and Android; anyone who sealed an Aniimo in the Bonded Promise event reclaims that companion by logging in with the same account.
timeline.estimate_basis: Sep 16 announced by Kingsglory and Pawprint Studio; aniimo.com and funplus.com still say Q3 2026 as of Aug 17

timeline.title: Pre-order editions
timeline.detail: The Advanced Edition ($9.99) bundles the Advanced Companion Handbook battle pass and a Prismana egg with perfect potential; the Collector's Edition ($19.99) adds a doll and avatar frame, and the Fluffy Friend accessory is a PlayStation pre-order exclusive.
